scope_gaps.note: The source tested the effect of receiving notifications during one laboratory attention task. It did not test muting in everyday focused work, and it does not distinguish needed from unneeded notifications ('niepotrzebne' is the editors' qualifier).
Same as title#1: the abstract shows that notifications alone disrupted an attention-demanding task, not that muting them in real tasks helps; 'niepotrzebne' is not a source category.
Design 'eksperyment' is not stated in the abstract; the sample, number of participants and task are also not given there.
The abstract gives no population, sample size, task description, notification type or effect size. The sentence claims none of these, but a reader may assume generality beyond one laboratory task.
'konkretnego zadania' is not identified in the abstract, which says only 'an attention-demanding task'.
